name: The Rasp's List
description: Every name the Unwritten ground out of the Long Tally, with its clan, its debt and the year it was set, in a tally-cutter's careful hand on stitched birch-bark. Thirty-one names. The last is Kadda ko-Kharrow, nine years' work, with no line through it.

name: Marrow-Iron
description: A bar of iron broken off the deep seam at Ghaleld, red as a scab where it broke and grained inside like bone. It is warm, and it rings for a long time when it is struck.

name: The Last Keeper's Day-Book
description: A keeper's day-book from Dunnow, the last thirty pages of it written by one hand.

name: The Overman's Book
description: Ghaleld's overman's book for the winter of 1001, kept in the store behind the drawing forge.

name: The Lampman's Tally
description: A winchman's book of everything that came up Oskel Gloup's rope, kept for forty years in a careful Oskel hand. The first page is the Salt boat's cargo, sold before she sailed. Under it, years later and in the same hand: the pilot was Keddo. I did not know.

name: The Salt Isles Cargo Book
description: The Salt Isles traders' book of tides and cargo, kept in the cave under Oskel Gloup and never carried home.
